Full summary: Closed the migrate-CLI worktree follow-up (decision 01KY68QNAF): runMigrateCli now defaults its project root through the canonical resolveProjectRoot instead of a private process.cwd() + --project parse — TWINING_PROJECT and the linked-worktree redirect (with TWINING_WORKTREE_LOCAL opt-out) apply to migrations exactly as to the server; explicit --project still passes through verbatim. Three new real-git tests (TWINING_PROJECT default, worktree redirect targets main store, opt-out keeps worktree-local). Bundled server rebuilt (carries the migrate code), plugin 1.20.1, CHANGELOG entries under 2.3.0 and Plugin 1.20.1. Full suite 1289 passed.
Decisions: Chose to keep the migrate CLI's own strict argument loop and only source the DEFAULT root from resolveProjectRoot (called with empty argv) rather than delegating --project parsing to the resolver — the CLI's parse rejects missing values and unknown flags with exit 2 and usage text, which the resolver's permissive indexOf lookup would silently weaken; the default path is where the env/worktree behavior belongs.; Chose a plugin patch bump (1.20.1) for the bundle refresh — no hook or launcher behavior changed, but the committed bundle content did, and the keyless freshness CI job on main requires the rebuilt bundle to be committed; a patch communicates content-only refresh to marketplace consumers.
